local-jsonl.durability_ceiling: local JSONL only with durable hash-chain, CloudEvents source/id replay rejection, and prepared-effect idempotency key reservation; signed terminal effect transition chains and pending-effect recovery reports are sqlite-wal only in rev0632 and this backend is not distributed or tamper-proof.

sqlite-wal.durability_ceiling: local SQLite/WAL only with durable hash-chain, CloudEvents source/id replay rejection, prepared-effect idempotency key reservation, append-only terminal effect transition chain, read-only pending-effect recovery report, rev0628 prepared ledger sequence/hash binding, rev0629 signed transition intents, rev0630 raw public transition API fail-closed behavior, and rev0631 per-ledger instance id binding for transition intents and rows; not distributed or tamper-proof.
sqlite-wal.restore_ceiling: Compiled restore requires current capability manifest v27, signed manifest v2 with signed manifest_revision_id and parent_revision payload fields, trust-profile v3 digest pin, schema v8 prepared-effect ledger entries plus ledger-instance-bound signed-intent append-only effect transition chain, read-only source/staged/destination snapshot verification including transition intent metadata, ledger instance binding, and prepared-row binding, rollback/prefix continuity, staged atomic replacement, restore lock, write gate, parent directory fsync, final destination verification, and raw terminal transition API fail-closed behavior; still local single-node evidence.

blocked_claim: Capability v27 does not claim deployed enforcement, client proof-of-possession, distributed exactly-once effects, external system rollback/compensation, HSM-managed keys, legal finality, full byte-for-byte cloned-ledger replay prevention, independent witness checkpoints, or multi-node consensus. Fixture HMAC proof binding remains local test evidence.
purpose: Slim C++ cube backend capability manifest v27. Replaces ambiguous newline-delimited ingress proof, effect-idempotency, and CloudEvents identity composition with byte-length-framed tuples; duplicate case-insensitive security metadata and ASCII control characters fail closed. Rev0631 transition intents remain scoped to a different initialized ledger instance, not to byte-for-byte clones carrying the same identity. SQLite compatibility fallback derivation is now symmetric with JSONL, and ledger instance generation fails closed on OpenSSL CSPRNG failure.

security_note: rev0632 closes a reproduced cross-field substitution in proof/effect/event identity material by using anonsync-length-prefixed-tuple-v1 and rejects control characters plus duplicate case-insensitive security metadata. Other legacy newline-delimited signed/hash inputs remain migration debt and are explicitly not covered by this capability. The capability document is still self-asserted until authenticated by an operator release root. New SQLite ledger identities use anonsync-sqlite-ledger-instance-v2 with OpenSSL RAND_bytes; no PID/time fallback remains.
